thread:
julian.k: hey team — adopted finalization today! 🎉 Can I add my child retro to the placement date (2026-10-03)? Also want to enroll in Dependent Care FSA and the adoption assistance reimbursement. SSN pending.

carmen: huge congrats!! Quick overview: adoption is a QLE. We can request medical/dental/vision retro to placement date but carrier approval required. For FSA/DC FSA there's usually a mid-year election window tied to the QLE — you can enroll in Dependent Care FSA mid-year if you submit the QLE within 30 days.

benefits-ops: required docs to upload to Workday Benefits: 
```
- court placement paperwork or agency placement letter (showing placement date 2026-10-03)
- final adoption decree when available
- SSN when it's issued (mark SSN pending in portal)
```

benefits-broker: note on carriers: major medical (group) typically allows retro to placement if enrollment is filed within 30 days and placement docs provided. Dental/vision often follow medical but verify. We'll flag urgent on the submission to expedite.

julian.k: for the Dependent Care FSA — do I need to specify annual election amount now and then payroll will prorate? Or is there a special rule for mid-year?

people-ops: you must select an annual election amount when enrolling. Payroll/benefits will prorate the per-pay-period deductions for the remainder of the plan year based on your chosen annual election and the effective date. If you want a smaller per-pay catch-up, you can pick a lower annual amount and adjust during the next OE.

payroll-bot: payroll note: once benefits confirms the enrollment effective date, payroll will implement per-pay deductions. If retro to 10/03 is approved, we'll calculate missed pre-tax contributions and you'll have options: 1) one-time catch-up on next payroll, 2) spread catch-up over N pay periods (request N in your ticket). For Dep Care FSA, limits are subject to IRS rules — check max contribution caps.

julian.k: also filing for adoption assistance reimbursement under Company policy — how does that flow?

carmen: adoption assistance: submit reimbursement request with receipts and final decree to people-ops > Adoption Assistance form. The company reimburses up to policy limits; reimbursements are processed via AP/Payroll and may be taxable depending on amount & timing. Benefits-ops will help route.

benefits-ops: next steps for you: 
```
1) Upload placement letter now and mark SSN pending.
2) Submit Workday QLE event (event date = 2026-10-03) and choose enrollments (medical, dental, vision, Dep Care FSA).
3) Indicate if you want catch-up for FSA as a single payroll or spread over X pays.
4) Submit Adoption Assistance reimbursement form separately for AP processing.
```

julian.k: uploading docs now and selecting spread over 3 pays for FSA catch-up. Thanks — can't wait to get this squared away. :heart:

benefits-ops: received docs (REQ-2456789012). We've opened carrier ticket REF-2456789012 and requested retro enrollment to 2026-10-03. Expect carrier response 5-8 business days. Payroll note: if approved, FSA catch-up spread over 3 pays as requested. We'll update once carrier confirms.

people-ops: congrats again — and FYI the adoption assistance form link: https://workday.redwood/forms/adoption-assist. DM us if you want help filling it out.
